digest.component_or_area: docs/exit-codes.md documentation and CLI exit status contract
propositions: docs/exit-codes.md declares itself the single source of truth but documents only 41 of 75 real dispatcher commands, with 34 omissions including review-plan, review-code, and verify-completion
Exit codes 75 (RebaseGuard/EXIT_RESCHEDULE), 78 (StoreIncompatibleError), 3, 4, and 12 reach the process exit status but appear nowhere in the documentation
The document's scope note incorrectly states only five commands validate unknown options; metrics, doctor, composer, and fsck all exit 2 on unknown options today
A CI check must enforce that every dispatcher arm has a corresponding row in the exit-codes table to prevent undocumented codes in new commands
The document must include a forward-compatibility statement that unknown non-zero exit codes MUST be treated as failure
